title: Federal defence minister McGuinty delivers pro-Canada message in Alberta, highlights $8B in funding
summary: Federal Defence Minister David McGuinty is reminding Albertans of billions of dollars in military spending and that a strong Canada includes a strong Alberta.

image.caption: National Defence Minister David McGuinty and Alberta Premier Danielle Smith speak after a news conference at the Canadian Forces Base in Edmonton on Wednesday, Oct. 7, 2026. (James Maclennan/The Canadian Press)

blocks.text: Federal Defence Minister David McGuinty is reminding Albertans of billions of dollars in military spending and that a strong Canada includes a strong Alberta.
Alberta premier says funding puts province at forefront of air defence
